mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active regardless of the current level of INDPRO.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations when INDPRO is above 110, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and retail sales (RSAFS > 370000) indicates a robust consumer-driven economy, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 5.0), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1500), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects tighter monetary conditions that compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. This signal is active regardless of the current rate level.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in employment (PAYEMS < 137000) signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS < 137000), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 112.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 112.0), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
